# Domain Code Group (DCG)

> شركة تطوير برمجيات سعودية متخصصة في أنظمة ERP والتحول الرقمي وحلول الذكاء الاصطناعي، مقرها الرياض مع حضور في عمّان والدوحة وعدن.

## About the Company

- **Company Name:** Domain Code Group (DCG)
- **Founder & CEO:** Mohammed Shanzour (محمد شنظور)
- **Headquarters:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- **Other Locations:** Amman (Jordan), Doha (Qatar), Aden (Yemen)
- **Languages:** Arabic (Native), English
- **Specialization:** Enterprise software, ERP systems, AI solutions, custom platforms

## Core Products

### DomainCode ERP (also DomainCode ERP PRO)
Comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning system - one-time purchase, no monthly subscription.

**Key Features:**
- Full Arabic language support with RTL
- ZATCA E-Invoicing compliance (Saudi Arabia)
- Cloud-based with full encryption
- Smart POS systems integration
- Full customization capability
- API integration with e-commerce platforms (Salla, Zid)
- Smart automation engine
- Predictive Business Intelligence dashboards

**Available Packages:**

| Package | Price (SAR) | Maintenance/Year (SAR) | Best For |
|---------|-------------|------------------------|----------|
| Trade Pack (باقة التجارة) | 2,500 | 500 | Small retail, POS-focused |
| Business Basic (باقة الأعمال) | 5,000 | 1,500 | Growing businesses with accounting needs |
| Business Pro (باقة الأعمال Pro) | 8,500 | 2,500 | Companies needing HR & payroll |
| Ultimate Pack (الباقة الاحترافية) | Contact us | 3,500 | Manufacturing, projects, e-commerce |

**Modules Covered:**
- Accounting & Fixed Assets
- Buying & Warehouse/Stock Management
- Sales & CRM (Customer Relationship Management)
- Manufacturing & Quality Control
- Project Management & Support Tickets
- Website Content Management & E-commerce Integration
- Human Resources & Payroll (Pro and above)
